purpose: identify, as far as the available evidence allows, why some GigaHands views reproject badly in CAM-EXP-001

input.dataset_re_read: only for lag, distortion, flip, hand-identity and figures

view_classification_rule.rule: Otsu split on log10(per-view median error) over non-sentinel views; good = median <= min(otsu/2, 10), bad = median >= max(otsu*2, 50), medium in between, zero-sentinel separate.

hypotheses.H7: hand identity swap in the 2D annotation (added after inspecting figures)

note: Thresholds are derived from the observed distribution (Otsu on log per-view median error), not fixed in code.
